text: The library should extend evening hours because it enhances the overall user experience. The proposed plan for night staffing, which includes a certified night staffing plan and a nighttime reading festival, significantly improves the library's offerings and safety. The lighting retrofit savings, which makes evening operation nearly free, also proves that the library is proactive and committed to ensuring a safe environment for its users. Furthermore, the fact that the neighboring branch successfully extended hours for two years and had similar safety and reliability measures demonstrates a commitment to quality and security. Ultimately, extending evening hours will benefit the library and enhance its reputation as a welcoming and safe destination for its users.
